name: What types of wood fences can you repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of wood fences can you repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: We repair various types of wood fences commonly found in the Berkeley, East Bay, and Oakland areas. This includes picket fences, privacy fences, semi-privacy fences, and ranch-style fences. Our services cover different wood species, such as redwood, cedar, and pressure-treated pine. We address issues specific to each fence type and wood material, ensuring appropriate repair methods are used to match existing structures and maintain aesthetic consistency.
acceptedAnswer.description: We repair picket, privacy, semi-privacy, and ranch-style wood fences made from various wood species like redwood, cedar, and pressure-treated pine.
